lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: A dayside kid. Awake. At- no. No no. What time is it?

lines.speaker: tadzio
lines.text: Two.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Fourteen lamps dark, the ladder's busted, and the Foreman counts every one.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: You- you'd do that? For a lamp? For me?

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Okay. Okay okay. Stand by the lamp, face it, and hold {confirm}. I'll do the flame part.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: The Foreman runs the Nightshift. Every lamp, every loaf, every minute.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: He has a clipboard. He has two pencils. If he finds out a dayside kid saw me, I'm- I don't know what I am. In trouble.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Sure. Fine. I'll be here. Under the busted ladder. Being fine.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Still awake? Still seeing me?

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: The lamp. Face it and hold {confirm}. You've got this. I think. I hope.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Wait! Not that way. Not alone. Not before the lamp!
The lamp catches. Warm light spills down the sidewalk.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: You did it. You actually held it!

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: I'm Wick. Apprentice lamplighter. Second class. Fourth class. Some class.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: I'm coming with you. Somebody has to explain things. Just- keep that flashlight off my face.
Wick joined you. Talk to him any time with {confirm}.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: One more thing. Lit lamps remember. The rest of the town forgets by morning.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: One less for the Foreman to count!

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Look at the street. Worth it? Your call.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Look at that. Look at it glow.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: You're good at this. Don't tell anyone I said so.
A streetlamp. Dark.
The lamp hums. It's a happy hum.
The only lamp that was already lit. Something has been circling it.
Dark. That one's on tomorrow's list, probably.
A ladder, snapped clean in two. It looks embarrassed about it.
Your own front door. Locked. You left through the back, like a burglar of your own house.
A neighbor's door.
TODO(Tadzio): who lives here?
A dark window. Somebody in there is asleep, and doing a great job of it.
Yesterday's bread, still on the step. Nobody came to take it back.
The Un-Baker's cart. Full of yesterday's bread. Nobody is pushing it.

wick_cart.todo: TODO(Tadzio): what Wick says at the Un-Baker's empty post.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: His cart. He never leaves his cart.
A mailbox. Empty. Even the mail is asleep.

unbaker_approach.todo: TODO(Tadzio): what workers say when they are afraid of Tadzio (many_gone).

lines.text: A tall figure stands by a cart. At every doorstep on this street, it takes the bread back.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: Twelve. Thirteen. Fourteen loaves. Yesterday's. All accounted for.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: You're not on my list. Nobody awake is on my list.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: I count workers too. There are fewer every night.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: That's the Un-Baker! He takes yesterday's bread back before morning. He's very, very particular.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: A kid off the list is a problem. I don't like problems. I like lists.

unbaker_approach_angry.todo: TODO(Tadzio): what the Un-Baker says the night after you let him go.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: You. The kid off the list. I did the whole route backward because of you.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: Not tonight. Tonight I count YOU.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: He gave you bread. He never gives anybody bread. He COUNTS it!

lines.speaker: tadzio
lines.text: It's just the heel.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: The heel is the best part. Everybody knows that.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Come on. The Depot's past Main Street. East.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Oh. He's going to tell the Foreman. He tells the Foreman everything.

lines.speaker: tadzio
lines.text: He was in the way.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: He was doing his job. At two in the morning that's kind of the same thing.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Come on. The Depot's past Main Street. East.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: Fourteen loaves. All yesterday's. All accounted for. Thanks to you.

lines.speaker: unbaker
lines.text: Don't eat the heel all at once. Make it last.
